svg.text: The shim sits between the legacy executable and Windows 11: it answers the version check and redirects the writes the app expects to make, while the OS itself stays unchanged.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Symptoms it answers: 'unsupported OS' at install (version check); works for admins but not operators (writes to Program Files or HKLM). Controls: Part 11 §11.10(a); Annex 11 configuration management.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
